---
title: "Modeling Practice"
format: html
editor: visual
---

read in the data 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
bike_data <- read_csv("https://www4.stat.ncsu.edu/~online/datasets/SeoulBikeData.csv",
local = locale(encoding = "latin1"))
bike_data
```

check the data for missing values
```{r}
bike_data |>
is.na()|>
colSums()
```

check column type and values 
```{r}
attributes(bike_data)$spec
```

fix date column
```{r}
bike_data <- bike_data |>
 mutate(date = lubridate::dmy(Date)) |>
 select(-Date)
```

summarize each column 
```{r}
summary(bike_data)
```
